about: The cargo_hold track's rig-look parts (ticket 580, wave 576-1A of the rig look ladder #576; the LK4 steps of ticket 812, wave 647-7K of the P1-P5 map #647): one asset at the track's attach slot, one part per look step. The thresholds are the band edges LK1 (#809) froze for the hold, step 11, and the names the data strings of 3 words or fewer the hover line shows (the first three Progression's, comment 6300549964); the wiring (#581) reads them from the rig-look registry (#577), not from here. lookBoxM is the box in the vehicle frame every look fits inside: the hatch, the pod's flank under it where the LK4 racks and panniers hang, and the stay up to the slot behind the ram; what the readability sheet measures a step over.
